title: Sign encoding of true
statement: Under the sign encoding $\sigma\colon \mathrm{Bool}\to\{-1,1\}$, which sends the truth value false to $1$ and true to $-1$, the truth value true is mapped to $-1$; that is, $\sigma(\text{true}) = -1$.
replaced:
Under the sign encoding $\sigma\colon\mathrm{Bool}\to\{-1,1\}$, the Boolean value
$\mathrm{false}$ is sent to $1$; that is, $\sigma(\mathrm{false}) = 1$.
